text: China's Q3 GDP grew 4.5% YoY versus 4.3% in Q2. September industrial output rose 5.5%, retail sales 1.1%, and the trade surplus reached $133.5B. Nine-month fixed asset investment fell 7.2%, property investment fell 20.6%, and consumer inflation remained below 1%.

meta.note: Export and domestic-sector indicators occupy opposing positions within the same aggregate growth measure.

text: A federal judge ordered former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan detained without bail on an alleged recording-device offense. The Saudi Consulate offered full bond funding and travel-document restrictions. The court identified significant flight risk and rejected the proposed release arrangement.

meta.note: Foreign consular assurances and U.S. judicial authority are distinct; no shared jurisdiction is established.
